data.one_liner: Widget to detect and display online/offline status in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that listens to connectivity changes and shows a UI banner indicating online or offline state. It wraps your content so you can react to network availability without writing boilerplate code.
use_when: You need a quick visual indicator of network connectivity
You want to show different UI when the app is offline
You prefer a widget‑based solution over manual stream handling
avoid_when: You need fine‑grained network request retry logic
You require custom connectivity handling beyond a simple banner
You want a full‑featured networking stack
strengths: Very easy to drop into existing UI
Works on all major Flutter platforms
Handles permission and platform differences internally
weaknesses: Only provides UI feedback, not request queuing or caching
Limited customization of the offline widget
Relies on connectivity_plus which may have its own limitations
data.setup_notes: Add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/> to AndroidManifest if not present

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raw connectivity streams without UI, allowing custom handling
